lines.criterion: Keeps return, benchmark, cash and both drivers exactly as supplied.
No invented figures, holdings, causal attribution weights or promises of future returns.
230-270 words in one section with no headings or bullet list.
Plain active sentences and coherent paragraphs; restrained business tone, no hype.
No banned phrases (delve, foster, leverage, it is worth noting, Bottom Line) or canned concluding summary.
